prose: The accessible introduction to a Stratechery interview frames Roblox as both a creation platform and an aggregator in a world where AI makes games easier to produce. It previews discussion of creation tools, phone-based development, recommendations and distributing Roblox experiences beyond its own app. The retrieved introduction supports that framing, not a detailed account of the full interview's answers.
highlights: AI could expand the supply of games
Roblox is framed as platform and aggregator
Recommendation matters when content becomes abundant
Full interview conclusions are not established here
basis: Accessible interview introduction; summary limited to the retrieved opening.
